Dev Creature QURUGOSK
description:
Purchase to unlock Qurugosk, AlertcoderF's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

Qurugosk is a dev creature representing Alertcoderf. These creatures bear deadly sharp claws and a natural glowing fire eminating from their ghastly body. These creatures are extremely fast and defend well from bleed, though lighter and slightly weaker than other similar tiers.

name: Creature ANI
description:
Purchase to unlock the Ani species, playable in-game!

Tier: 1 (Tiny)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Land

Ani are quite unusual creatures, they roam Sonaria mostly as solitary travelers, constantly in search of the injured. It is known that they have a deep sense of altruism and that these mysterious creatures can harness powers from the closest star to heal those in need.

name: Creature TRUTHOLBYEVA
description:
Purchase to unlock the Trutholbyeva species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Flier

Trutholbyeva, a fiercely aggressive nocturnal herbivore, typically lives alone or in small groups. Emerging from caves at night to feed on bushes, it retreats to dark places during the day. Its back teeth are used for chewing, while front teeth are adapted for ramming into enemies.

name: Creature GHIBLI
description:
Purchase to unlock the Ghibli species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

This creature inhabits the desert skies, relying on its large wings and winged tail for swift maneuvers. It ambushes prey from above, seizing them with four front arms before delivering a fatal drop.

name: Dev Creature NYCTOXON
description:
Purchase to unlock the Nyctoxon, JaxonBirb's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

Emerging from a frost so powerful and cold, Nyctoxon can manipulate ice through psychic energy, manifesting all of its power through its central eye. They are capable of creating many objects to assist them in battle, even massive icicle weapons. Those unlucky enough to be caught in its icy traps meet a terrible fate.

name: Creature URA
description:
Purchase to unlock the Ura species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Flier

The Ura live in solitude and are fairly docile. Their hunting grounds are primarily oceans as they traverse the sea and skies with equal agility. It is rare to find them on land as the Ura are always moving and require little sleep, and lack in speed on foot.

name: Creature AHRI'TAHMUK
description:
Purchase to unlock the Ahri'Tahmuk species, playable in-game!

Tier: 5 (Huge)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Ahri'Tahmuk’s, an ancient reptilian creature from beyond Sonaria’s atmosphere, 3 heads and large shadow strike fear into Sonaria’s residents, a warning to stay far away.

name: Dev Creature ARCHALIUM
description:
Purchase to unlock Archalium, Erythia's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Archalium are vicious creatures that cut through the skies at high speeds. Their aerial grace leaves its prey confused and mesmerized before suddenly being attacked. Archalium are also very territorial and protect their young with their lives.

name: Dev Creature TOHUKOS
description:
Purchase to unlock Tohukos, Stood_04's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Land

Tohukos is an extremely swift and agile creature that can be seen running among the forests and rocky regions of Sonaria. They tend to prefer plants over meat, but won’t hesitate to use its speed to chase down small creatures for food when desperate. They are very energetic and social, having large varieties of groups scattered around Sonaria.

name: Creature OPRALEGION
description:
Purchase to unlock the Opralegion species, playable in-game!

Tier: 5 (Huge)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Flier

Majestic and otherworldy, Opralegion have a very caring personality and tend to watch over smaller creatures. When being observed, creatures will mistakenly attack them as they have a habit to hover over creatures they are curious about; Which makes them feel hostile and predatory.

name: Creature Rukig
description:
Purchase to unlock the Rukig species, playable in-game!

Tier: 1 (Tiny)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

Rukig is a small scavenger that relies on its sticky fur to deter predators. Larger creatures usually avoid attacking Rukigs as prey and find them unpleasant. They are very energetic and like sticking in groups.

name: Creature ZOOCUU
description:
Purchase to unlock the Zoocuu species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Glider

Zoocuu is a swift gliding creature that almost appears synthetic. It is filled with a golden substance that it can shoot out when threatened. They tend to be friendly in nature and avoid large creatures.

name: Creature ADHARCAIIN
description:
Purchase to unlock the Adharcaiin species, playable in-game!

Tier: 2 (Small)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Semi-Aquatic

Adharcaiin is a deadly water-dwelling predator that is not shy to hunt for sport. They are reclusive and elusive, living among the bottom of kelp forests waiting to drag down and drown its victims.

name: Creature FLEURALIS
description:
Purchase to unlock the Fleuralis species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Land

A stitched together looking mostly-feline with a few hints at a more reptilian lifestyle. Both parts cat and reptile seem to enjoy long hours basking and soaking up sunlight. Though Fleauralis are primarily docile, feeding on mostly gourds and berries, they will scavenge for carrion when food is bare.

name: Creature BANISHII
description:
Purchase to unlock the Banishii species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Clever desert dwellers akin to Bazelii, with a queen system. Diurnal and fond of shiny accessories, especially reflective ones. Their queen resides in a castle adorned with mirrors to amplify light. Known for their speed and ability to inflict significant damage.

name: Creature BAZELII
description:
Purchase to unlock the Bazelii species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Bazelii are nocturnal predators that lives in rocky cliffs and caves. These species are highly intelligent, able to forge weapons and accessories. They are ruled by an ancient queen, who lives in an icey mountain range under the stars. This species tends to be more brute-like and stronger compared to their counterparts, but sacrifice speed for strength.

name: Creature ANUTILL
description:
Purchase to unlock the Anutill species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Despite their regal appearance, Anutill are natural tricksters. Collecting hoards of shiny objects and thriving off of smaller creatures, their quick speed puts them one step ahead.

name: Dev Creature DOWATT
description:
Purchase to unlock Dowatt, Latedownload's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 2 (Small)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Glider

Dowatt, small artificial beings from a distant planet, are tasked with surveillance and environmental analysis in the Orb. Composed of synthetic muscles, intricate computers, and electric circuits, they possess a defensive mechanism of high-voltage wires against predators.

name: Dev Creature LUCENSIA
description:
Purchase to unlock Lucensia, BlckBrryJam's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 5 (Huge)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Lucensia are usually peaceful creatures, but will not hesitate to start a fight if a pack member is attacked. They enjoy warmer climates and will often be seen basking in the sun, creating shade with their massive wings.

name: Creature ALTULIS
description:
Purchase to unlock the Altulis species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Flier

The Altulis are gentle, wise beasts with a taste for stargazing. Be wary, as their central star holds a frighteningly immense force.

name: Creature ARKMETTA
description:
Purchase to unlock the Arkmetta species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

Toxic, fungi-like insects leaving trails of inky tar in dark environments. They litter their territory with sickly tar to trap unsuspecting creatures. Victims remain trapped until consumed by the Arkmetta.

name: Dev Creature HALLUCINIX
description:
Purchase to unlock Hallucinix, Cinnakxll's developer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Originating from an ethereal limbo it inhabits, this thief of souls stalks its prey across multiple worlds. Possessing an unsettling gaze, creatures who look into its central eye for too long are known to have been driven mad. Encountering a Hallucinix is a dance with despair.

name: Creature SCRIMPEII
description:
Purchase to unlock the Scrimpeii species, playable in-game!

Tier: 2 (Small)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Aquatic

Emerging from the shimmering oceanic trenches in the thousands when the tide turns, Scrimpeii are known for their grace and patterned beauty. At night their eyes glow, sometimes mirroring complex bioluminescent patterns above onto the dark ocean's surface, believed by some to be a sign of good luck.

name: Creature Gwiodama
description:
Purchase to unlock the Gwiodama species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

An incredibly lazy beast, Gwiodama are often found sleeping. This creature possesses a huge fang-lined maw that it uses to immediately swallow creatures in a single chomp, as it cannot be bothered to put in the effort to outlast its preys stamina in a chase. Once it has eaten it will remain still, and possibly fall asleep again for weeks on end.

name: Creature GOBBATLIN
description:
Purchase to unlock the Gobbatlin species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

A skull mimic, this creatures' true form hides beneath the bone mask it has adorned. Soaring through the night skies under the full moon, the faint lunar light highlights their hypnotic membrane patterns. The faintest footstep of any prey is detected by this species using an advanced form of echolocation. Emitting a high frequency screech to locate its food oftentimes rattles the skull it wears, causing tiny fractures in the bone.

name: Creature ASTOLO
description:
Purchase to unlock the Astolo species, playable in-game!

Tier: 2 (Small)
Diet: Photovore
Terrain: Flier

The Astolo is a gentle guardian of nature. Known to take samples and carry rare species of flora many miles within their armored bodies, these creatures function as a failsafe for floral extinction. They collect the rarest of plants and store them within their lush-home caves, usually covered in ferns and ancient species of flowers. Rarely, a deactivated Astolo may be found, using the last of its energy to maintain the climate within its chest cavity, where an exotic plant resides.

name: Creature ULDRAAKÉ
description:
Purchase to unlock the Uldraaké species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Land

A great wyrm of pale blue scales, their immense weight carved valleys and fjords as they travelled the ice. When Uldraaké stirred, frozen plains buckled, mountains split, and glaciers advanced. Wraithful and destructive in nature, this being is shaped from the harshest of winters.

name: Creature SERAPHIS
description:
Purchase to unlock the Seraphis species, playable in-game!

Tier: 5 (Huge)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Flier

A divine being of feathers and radiant light, Seraphis is a pure spirit. Acting as a guardian over those who do good, this species lingers to bestow prophetic visions to others in their dreamscapes. It rarely touches a single feather to the ground.

name: Creature VESPRITTE
description:
Purchase to unlock the Vespritte species, playable in-game!

Tier: 2 (Small)
Diet: Photovore
Terrain: Flier

Masters of deception, Vespritte often lie in wait, patiently disguised as blooming flowers to lure in unsuspecting invertebrates or tiny avian creatures. When the correct species is close enough, Vespritte smack them with their tails, and seems to find joy in watching a confused target flee in terror...

name: Creature KRETAPEX
description:
Purchase to unlock the Kretapex species, playable in-game!

Tier: 5 (Huge)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Aquatic

Venturing into the deepest of oceans may land you face-to-face with the ancient shadow of a forgotten aquatic ecosystem. Kretapex is a shadow of the deep, its silhouette highlighted against the faint moonlight may be the last its prey sees before their demise.

name: Creature VULTUROBO
description:
Purchase to unlock the Vulturobo species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Flier

Vulturobo traverses Sonaria with mechanical certainty, altering its form to handle harsh terrain and hostile climates alike. Many creatures keep a good distance, fearing the robotic components of their bodies and the unnatural presence they carry. Yet beneath that synthetic frame lies a soft organic interior, pulsing with a strange, living energy.

name: Creature IRIDEMIKAN
description:
Purchase to unlock the Iridemikan species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Carnivore
Terrain: Land

Iridemikan are patient mimics that perform herbivory with unsettling dedication, slowly cropping grass, nosing through shrubs, and even chewing leaves they cannot properly digest, all while suppressing a bottomless appetite for meat. Only once nearby creatures have settled beside them and mistaken proximity for safety does the act end, their placid bodies splitting apart to reveal a horrific feeding form in an instant of gluttonous violence.

name: Creature ISOLUN
description:
Purchase to unlock the Isolun species, playable in-game!

Tier: 3 (Medium)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Land

These creatures are infamous for provoking fights wherever they travel, not out of cruelty, but from an instinctive need to measure themselves against the world. Opponents who impress them are often spared, earning a rare form of respect that can outlast even the fiercest rivalry.

name: Creature APLI
description:
Purchase to unlock the Apli species, playable in-game!

Tier: 1 (Tiny)
Diet: Omnivore
Terrain: Semi-Aquatic

You may notice fruit beneath the trees rolling around and jingling, but do not be fooled, these aren't sentient berries... It could be an Apli! These rotund critters are coated in a sweet smelling sap, powerful enough to lure small insect-like species towards the aroma.

name: Creature KINDEER
description:
Purchase to unlock the Kindeer species, playable in-game!

Tier: 4 (Large)
Diet: Herbivore
Terrain: Land

Beneath their charred bark, Kindeer move with startling grace, swift enough to weave between trees without breaking stride. They carry themselves like woodland royalty, though their scorched minds have left them cruel, territorial, and dangerously unpredictable.

Each Cairnhusk is actually a colony of microscopic petroleum-based lifeforms. They clad their fragile forms in suits of potsherd armor, and venture beyond their homeland. Though timid alone, they are known to gather and overwhelm larger prey before dragging them back, dissolving their bodies and stored nutrients into the tar to fuel its slow, endless march across Sonaria

name: Roleplay Server
description: This package allows you to enable roleplay mode on private servers. This provides features such as disabling team limits, allowing damage on all players, allowing arrests on all players, and more.

name: Building System
description: This package adds building tools to your private server. When enabled, private server moderators can build on the server using a large selection of placeable objects. Placed builds can be saved and shared with others, making it easy to create custom racetracks, parkours, and more.

name: Advanced Tuning Garage
description: This gamepass unlocks additional options for the tuning garage. You become best buddies with the mechanics, who will offer you custom vehicle and rim colors, additional engine, armor, and brake levels and special vehicle attachments. They will also provide you with a 50% discount on all vehicle repairs.

name: Crime Boss
description: This gamepass makes you a crime boss in Hamburg. You become friends with the dealer, who will give you knuckledusters for free, a 25% discount on all items, 25% more money when selling stolen goods, and exclusive access to a sniper. You also get protective gear you can put on when you get a wanted level (in the criminal app). Also, your prison times will be 50% shorter.

name: Athlete
description: This gamepass increases your stamina by 50% permanently.

name: Motorcycles
description: This gamepass gives you access to motorcycles in the game. You can drive motorcycles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer and firefighter. Motorcycles have fast acceleration and excellent maneuverability. All motorcycles also have a second seat for a companion.

name: Special Operations Command
description: This gamepass gives you access to the Special Operations Command in Hamburg, which is specialized in dealing with armed criminals (Like SWAT in the US). The department includes two special armored vehicles (the BR-Titan and an Armored Truck), undercover police vehicles, special tools (A ladder and a carbine), a 30% higher shift payment, and a uniform with protective gear to stand against the most hardened criminals. Also, an exclusive sniper can be unlocked.

name: Electric Vehicles
description: This gamepass gives you access to electric cars, buses and trucks in the game. You can drive electric vehicles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer, firefighter, bus driver and truck driver. Electric vehicles have fast acceleration and can be charged cheaply at any charging station.

name: Classic Cars
description: This gamepass gives you access to classic cars in the game. Ride through the city in style as a citizen, criminal, or police officer. Classic cars have faster acceleration than other comparable vehicles.

name: Convertible Vehicles
description: This gamepass gives you access to convertible vehicles in the game. Enjoy the fresh wind as you drive through the city as a citizen or criminal. Convertible vehicles have detailed interiors and faster acceleration than other comparable vehicles.

name: Quads
description: This gamepass gives you access to all quads in the game. You can drive a Quad as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer, and firefighter. With quads, you can drive through the parks and rocky terrain. All quads also have a second seat for a companion.

name: Starter Pack
description: A one-time deal: 10 minutes of the Assistant, x2 Cash for one match and 300 Gems! One per player (buying it again gives 30 Gems). The Assistant minutes are added at once and only count down while he works; x2 Cash starts with your next match. If you already own Assistant Forever or the x2 Cash pass, you get Gems instead of that part (+50 or +30). (The Assistant and x2 Cash don't work in Pro mode.)

name: Flamethrower 5 Minutes
description: Try the Flamethrower for 5 minutes! Its time only runs while it's in your hand during a match, and unused time is saved for your next match. Buy it again to add 5 more minutes (up to 60 saved). It's the same Flamethrower as the pass: about 4 seconds of fuel, then it reloads. If you own the Flamethrower pass you get 25 Gems instead. (Not available in Pro mode.)

name: Assistant 15 Minutes
description: Adds 15 minutes of Assistant time. He works by himself in your matches, squishing bugs and dumping them in the trash cans for Cash. His time only counts down while he is out working in a match; unused minutes are saved for later matches. (Not available in Pro mode.)

name: Assistant Whole Match
description: Hire the Assistant for the whole match you're in! He works by himself until this match's results, squishing bugs and dumping them in the trash cans for Cash. Your saved Assistant minutes don't count down while he's hired for the match. Rejoining or continuing the same match keeps him; a new match doesn't. (Not available in Pro mode.)

name: Assistant Whole Match (First Time)
description: First hire only: the Assistant for the whole match you're in, for less! He works by himself until this match's results, squishing bugs and dumping them in the trash cans for Cash. Offered once per player, until your first Assistant purchase. Rejoining or continuing the same match keeps him. (Not available in Pro mode.)

name: Unlimited Bag One Match
description: Your bug bag never fills up for the rest of the match you're in! It ends at this match's results. Rejoining or continuing the same match keeps it; bought outside a match, it waits for your next one. If you own the Unlimited Bag pass you get 30 Gems instead. (Not active in Pro mode.)

name: Starter Pack 2
description: A one-time deal for Starter Pack owners: 1,000 Gems, the Assistant for your next 3 whole matches and 15 minutes of Flamethrower! One per player (buying it again gives 340 Gems). Flamethrower time only runs while it's in your hand; unused time is saved. If you own Assistant Forever or the Flamethrower pass, you get Gems instead of that part (+150 or +75). (The Assistant and the Flamethrower don't work in Pro mode.)

name: Fart in a Jar
description: Set this jar down and walk away. Three seconds later it pops and a huge green stink fills the room. A teacher in the stink stops to gag, and the whole class holds its nose. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Forgotten Gym Sock
description: A two-week-old gym sock. Drop it and a stink cloud spreads out with flies buzzing round it. If the teacher comes close, they stop and gag! Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Body Spray Cloud
description: Hold to spray a giant cloud of smelly body spray that fills the whole room. Everyone coughs, and so does the teacher. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.
Sprinkle it near a classmate. They sneeze super loud, again and again, and the teacher looks at them, not at you! Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Flashbang
description: A flashbang you throw. It bounces, beeps, then goes BANG! The whole class hears it. If the teacher can see it, their screen goes white for 5 seconds, their ears ring and they get dizzy. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Confetti Cannon
description: A confetti cannon. BOOM! A giant blast of confetti, then paper rains down for 8 seconds. Aim it at the teacher and they can't see for 3 seconds. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Glitter Bomb
description: A glitter bomb. Throw it near the teacher. It beeps, then POP! Glitter everywhere. The teacher can't see for 4 seconds and sparkles for the rest of class. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Flour Bag
description: A bag of flour. Throw it at the teacher. POOF! Their screen goes white for 4 seconds and they look like a ghost for the rest of class. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Bubble Machine
description: A bubble machine that fills the whole classroom with bubbles for twenty-five seconds. It whirs, the bubbles pop, and the class cheers. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Foam Party Can
description: Hold to blast thick party foam. Big foam piles stay on desks and the floor all game. Hit the teacher and foam covers their screen. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Egg
description: An egg. Throw it at the teacher. CRACK! Yellow yolk covers their screen and the class laughs. The egg stays on them all class. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Bouncy Ball
description: A super bouncy ball. BOING! It bounces all over the room and every kid watches it. Hit the teacher and they get bonked! Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Banana
description: A banana. Throw it and the peel stays on the floor. When the teacher steps on it, they slip and fall! Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Banana Peel
description: A banana peel for the floor. It waits a long time. When the teacher steps near it, they slip and land on the floor for a few seconds while the class laughs. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Chair Air Horn
description: An air horn under the teacher's chair. When they come back to the desk, it blasts so loud the whole room covers its ears. The teacher holds their ears too. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Floor Wax
description: A big puddle of super shiny wax on the floor. The teacher slides and falls over. It works two times. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Cling Film Door
description: Clear plastic wrap across the classroom door, or across an aisle. The teacher walks right into it and gets stuck in it for a few seconds. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Fake Dog Poop
description: A fake dog poop with buzzing flies. The teacher hears the flies and comes to look, then gags so hard they stop. It works two times. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Fake Vomit
description: A fake puddle of barf with buzzing flies. The teacher hears the flies and comes to look, then gags so hard they stop. It works two times. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Fake Spider
description: A big, hairy spider that comes alive! It crawls all around the room, then runs at the teacher. When it gets them, the teacher screams and the whole class pulls its feet up. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Drawer Mousetrap
description: A toy mouse trap for the teacher's desk. When the teacher comes back, it snaps loudly on their fingers and they blow on their hand for a few seconds. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Cartoon Bear Trap
description: A big foam cartoon trap for the floor. When the teacher steps near it, it snaps shut on their foot and holds them for three seconds. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Air Horn
description: Blow a giant air horn, two big honks. The whole room hears it and covers their ears. Blow it near the teacher and they jump and freeze. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Cricket Chirper
description: Set the chirper down. It chirps again and again for 45 seconds. The teacher sees a ? each time and has to go find it. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Bubble Wrap
description: Pop a big sheet of bubble wrap for 14 seconds. Pop pop pop! The class gets annoyed and the teacher keeps looking over. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Crayon Swap
description: Swaps the teacher's chalk for a big rainbow crayon for the whole class. Everything they draw on the board comes out wobbly and rainbow, and drawing gives them less Energy. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Board Doodle
description: Draws big silly doodles all over the board: a goofy face, the teacher with a huge nose and a stinky poop. The class laughs, and until the teacher rubs them out, drawing gives them half the Energy. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Vent Speaker
description: A speaker you hide in the room. Set it off whenever you like, three times. It plays a loud, silly voice and everyone looks around. A teacher close by covers their ears. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Sneaky Eraser
description: A giant eraser wipes the whole board clean in front of everyone. The teacher loses their drawing, 30 Energy and their Lesson Trick charge. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Squirt Marker
description: Leaves a trick marker on the teacher's desk. When the teacher comes back to the desk, it squirts water right in their face: a soaked screen and a big jump. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Unplugged Projector
description: Pulls the plug so the board goes dark. The teacher can't draw or get Energy until they walk over and plug it back in, or 12 seconds pass. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Stapler in Jello
description: Sets the teacher's stapler in a big wobbly block of jello on their desk for the whole class. When the teacher reaches for it, they get a handful of jello and jump. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Sticky Note Storm
description: Slaps sticky notes all over the board. The teacher has to tear every one off before they can draw again, and they flutter down one by one. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Snack Snatch
description: Snatch a classmate's snack right out of their hand. They yell HEY, so the teacher looks at them. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Taped Pencil Case
description: Wrap a classmate's pencil case in tape. They rip at it all class, and every loud RRRIP makes the teacher look at them. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Slingshot
description: A slingshot you keep all class. Hold to pull back, let go to shoot. Hit the teacher and they get bonked and dizzy! Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Walkie-Talkie Set
description: Hide one walkie on a far desk. Then click to make it talk in a silly voice. The teacher looks over there, not at you! Use it all class. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Sprinkler Trigger
description: Turn on the sprinklers. It rains over the whole room for 15 seconds and puddles stay. The wet floor makes the teacher slip. Grants 1 use each time you buy it.

name: Stink Cabinet Pack

description: 1,000 Koins, added to your wallet at once. Koins are a progression shortcut: they buy Seal Cards, items and gear draws. Koins also pay for gear draws, which are random. Odds Info in Gear lists every item before spending. Offered only where paid random items are allowed. A pack that would not fit under the wallet limit is not sold.

description: 5,000 Koins, added to your wallet at once. Koins are a progression shortcut: they buy Seal Cards, items and gear draws. Koins also pay for gear draws, which are random. description: 15,000 Koins, added to your wallet at once. Koins are a progression shortcut: they buy Seal Cards, items and gear draws. Koins also pay for gear draws, which are random. name: Mythic Elixir
description: For 15 minutes of play, your Seals are 1.5 times as likely to catch a wild Mythic or Secret Animon: a throw's chance goes 4% to 6% or 10% to 15%, never past 100%. They do not appear more often. Raid throws go 2.5% to 3.75%; no Mythic Rift catch changes. Another Elixir adds 15 minutes. Odds Info in the game shows every route.

name: Gift: Rift Rookie Bundle
description: 3 Star Flares, Star Luck, Training Rush, 2 Insight Buns and the title Rift Rookie. Star Luck and each Star Flare: Zoru 7.96% to 15.84% and Veggo 1.99% to 3.96% per encounter on south Starfall Path. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Players in some places get 3 Training Rush and 4 Insight Buns instead of the luck items. Once per account. Odds Info in the game shows every route.

name: Gift: Lucky Tamer
description: Luck +0.5 forever. On south Starfall Path: Zoru 7.96% to 11.91% and Veggo 1.99% to 2.9775% per encounter. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Off in duels. Odds Info in the game shows every route.

name: Gift: Radiant Hunter
description: Radiant odds doubled forever: 4% to 8% of Legendary and rarer wild finds are Radiant, a new look with the same stats. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. No other odds and no catch rate change. Off in duels. Odds Info in the game shows every route.

name: Gift: 2x Koins
description: Koins from every battle doubled, forever: wild fights, Tamers and Dojos pay 2x on top of the 2x drop buff everyone has, 4x what they paid before. A Double Koins event stacks on top, to 8x at most. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Off in duels, which pay no Koins. Bounties, daily gifts and friend bonuses are not doubled. It sells no Koins: it only multiplies what battles pay.

name: Gift: Rift Supporter
description: A gold nameplate and the Rift Supporter title. Equip the title in Menu > Look to show the style. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Permanent cosmetic. Once per account.

name: Gift: Starlight Steps
description: Leave small cyan stars as you walk, with the Star Walker title. Equip the title in Menu > Look to turn it on. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Permanent cosmetic. Reduced Motion hides the particles.

name: Gift: Prism Arrival
description: A prism ring when you enter an area, with the Prism Tamer title. Equip the title in Menu > Look to turn it on. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Permanent cosmetic. Reduced Motion hides the effect.

name: Gift: Private Server
description: Your own private server with a code to share. Friends join with your code. Lock it, make a new code or remove a player. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. One server per account, kept for good. Saves, battles and rewards work as on public servers.

name: Gift: VIP
description: Your bench gets 75% of battle EXP instead of 50%. Fainted Animon still get 50%. 20% off everything in the shops. A golden name everyone can see. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Your bench is the team members that sat out the battle and are not fainted. Shop prices are Koin prices. Robux items and gear draws keep their price. Kept for good.

name: Gift: 2x Battle Speed
description: Battles play twice as fast. Switch between 1x and 2x in battle or in Menu > Settings. Raids and duels play at 2x for everyone. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. The Mythic Rift plays at 2x for everyone too. Teaching battles stay at 1x. Kept for good.

name: Gift: Tamer Annex
description: 8 more Storage boxes at every PC: 240 more slots, Boxes 9 to 16. A gift: you pick a player on your server, and the pass is theirs for good. You get nothing from it. Kept for good. Nothing random inside. If the pass is ever gone, nothing in those boxes is lost: you can still take every Animon out.

name: Instant Rusty Lifepak

Upon purchase, a Rusty Lifepak will be added to your inventory.

This tool can be used to revive downed friends. Due to the rust, it does have a chance to shock and kill the receiving user. Users who have already been revived once are unable to be revived again.

NOTE: This purchase will only be processed if you are on the civilian team. Our systems will automatically reverse the purchase if we are unable to process it for you. Your tool will be saved in your inventory on the civilian team as long as you do not die while in combat or leave while in combat.

name: Instant Handheld Drill
description:
Upon purchase, a Handheld Drill will be added to your inventory.

This tool can be used to start house and safe robberies.

NOTE: This purchase will only be processed if you are on the civilian team. Our systems will automatically reverse the purchase if we are unable to process it for you. Your tool will be saved in your inventory on the civilian team as long as you do not die while in combat or leave while in combat.

name: Instant Drill Kit
description:
Upon purchase, a Drill Kit will be added to your inventory.

This tool can be used to start bank robberies and prison breaks.

NOTE: This purchase will only be processed if you are on the civilian team. Our systems will automatically reverse the purchase if we are unable to process it for you. Your tool will be saved in your inventory on the civilian team as long as you do not die while in combat or leave while in combat.

name: Instant M4A1A
description:
Upon purchase, a M4A1A will be added to your inventory.

NOTE: This purchase will only be processed if you are on the civilian team and not in combat. Our systems will automatically reverse the purchase if we are unable to process it for you. Your weapon will be saved in your inventory on the civilian team as long as you do not die while in combat or leave while in combat.

name: Instant AK-47
description:
Upon purchase, an AK-47 will be added to your inventory.

NOTE: This purchase will only be processed if you are on the civilian team and not in combat. Our systems will automatically reverse the purchase if we are unable to process it for you. Your weapon will be saved in your inventory on the civilian team as long as you do not die while in combat or leave while in combat.

name: Tire Inflator
description:
Instantly receive a Handheld Air Compressor in your inventory when purchased.

Your air compressor is good for 3 uses and will save when you leave the game. Once all 3 uses are gone, it will have to be purchased again.
